guidance.statement: The long-term aspiration remains unchanged at 26% to 28%.
guidance.quote: Overall, our long-term aspiration remains unchanged, continues to be 26% to 28%.

delivered.statement: Revenue for the quarter was ₹73,188 crore, up 0.5% sequentially in constant currency.
Annualized AI revenue reached $3.1 billion and crossed 10% of overall revenue.
TCV for the quarter was US$9.6 billion, excluding Porsche and Best Buy deals.
Operating margins remained stable sequentially at 24% and net margins were 19%.
LTM attrition in IT services reduced by 30 basis points sequentially to 13.3%.
Workforce reached 598,056 associates with learning hours increasing 17% QoQ to 17.1 million.

calls.tone: confident on AI momentum and medium-term demand, cautious on near-term margin headwinds and investments.

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned whether AI-driven productivity and deflation offset incrementality or substitute traditional services.
Repeated questioning on when margins will return to 25-26% given mounting subcontractor costs and investments.
Pressed on the 10% sequential decline in India revenue and drop in large client metrics.
Scrutinized the sharp rise in subcontracting expenses and whether it is a proxy for visa cost pressures.

business.summary: Tata Consultancy Services is an IT services, consulting, and business solutions organization providing a comprehensive range of software, digital transformation, and AI-led technology services to global enterprises.

guidance.statement: We want to exit at 25% plus and strive to achieve it sooner rather than later.
guidance.quote: We want to exit at 25% plus and strive to achieve it sooner rather than later.

guidance.statement: Manufacturing, life sciences, and demand in general are expected to turn around in Q2.
guidance.quote: Manufacturing, we believe will turn around in Q2, life sciences could turn around in Q2, tech services will continue to grow.

delivered.statement: Q1 revenue stood at ₹72,275 crore, growing 2.2% sequentially and 13.9% year-on-year.
Delivered a TCV of $9.5 billion in Q1 FY27, including mega deal wins.
AI services annualized revenue stands at $2.6 billion, up 13.6% QoQ.
Operating margins for the quarter stood at 24%, down 130 bps sequentially.
Net margin for the quarter was 19.2%.
Total workforce at the end of the quarter stood at 593,798.

calls.tone: Optimistic on demand recovery and AI growth, despite near-term geopolitical and macroeconomic headwinds.

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned the impact of geopolitical uncertainties and if demand would recover in Q2.
Scepticism regarding revenue deflation and how much productivity has been passed on to clients.
Questioned why hiring and wage hikes occurred when AI is expected to reduce white-collar jobs.
Addressed the lower sequential addition in AI revenue compared to the previous quarter.

guidance.statement: We are looking at a regular Q1, regular Q2 that we are used to seeing.
guidance.quote: We are looking at a regular Q1, regular Q2 that we are used to seeing, and this is the way we are looking at as we stand now

guidance.statement: The immediate margin headwinds entering FY27 would be annual wage increments and build-acquire-partner investments.
guidance.quote: Stepping into FY27, the immediate headwinds would be the annual increments which we have talked about. And also, as you rightly mentioned, we'll continue our focus on the build, acquire and partner framework

guidance.statement: We'd like to move towards 26% operating margin on a longer-term basis.
guidance.quote: We'd like to move towards 26%, but on a longer-term basis.

delivered.statement: Q4 revenue was ₹70,698 crore, up 5.4% QoQ, with constant currency sequential growth of 1.2%.
Q4 operating margin stood at 25.3%, a sequential increase of 10 basis points.
Q4 order book performance was very strong with $12 billion in TCV including three mega deals.
Annualized AI revenues surpassed $2.3 billion in Q4.
Full year FY26 operating margin was 25%, an expansion of 70 basis points YoY and a 4-year high.
Full year FY26 TCV reached $40.7 billion including 5 mega deals.

calls.tone: confident on demand, order book momentum and AI scale, while navigating strategic investments and select regional caution

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned whether frequent frontier model launches and agentic AI updates cause clients to defer IT spending.
Pressured on the wider growth gap with peers and whether margins should be compromised to boost growth.
Asked if the higher SG&A expenses in the second half represent a new normal going forward.
Questioned the rationale for reinstating annual wage increments amidst ongoing macro uncertainties.

guidance.statement: We are confident of a good CY2026 based on client conversation, deal momentum and AI leadership.
guidance.quote: Based on client conversation, strong deal momentum and the leadership we are gaining in AI, we are confident of a good CY2026.

guidance.statement: We want to inch closer to our 26% to 28% margin band and make all efforts to climb towards 26%.
guidance.quote: while we will not shy away from making investments, we want to inch closer to our 26% to 28% band and we'll make all efforts to climb towards 26%.

guidance.statement: We expect the ongoing impact of the new labor code to be minimal, around 10 to 15 basis points.
guidance.quote: We expect the ongoing impact to be minimal, around 10 to 15 basis points.

guidance.statement: It continues to be our aspiration to make every effort to grow better than FY25 in FY26 in international markets.
guidance.quote: it continues to be our aspiration that we would make every effort. We saw demand slowly picking up in Q2 that continued in Q3. We are taking every step to ensure that we grow better than FY '25 in FY '26 in the international market.

guidance.statement: Data center build out typically requires about 18 months post securing an anchor customer, before revenue starts ticking in.
guidance.quote: Typically build out would require about 18 months, post which revenue should start ticking in.

delivered.statement: Delivered ₹67,087 crore in revenue, growing 2.0% sequentially in reported currency and 0.8% in constant currency.
Operating margins stood stable sequentially at 25.2%, excluding one-offs.
AI services generated annualized revenue of US$1.8 billion, growing at 17.3% QoQ in constant currency.
Achieved an overall TCV of US$9.3 billion, with BFSI TCV at US$3.8 billion and North America TCV at US$4.9 billion.
Headcount stood at 582,163 with LTM voluntary IT services attrition at 13.5%.

calls.tone: Optimistic on AI demand, deal momentum, and CY2026 outlook, while managing seasonal softness and labor regulations.

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned whether softness in North America and UK was solely due to seasonality or structural issues.
Analysts pressed on the sharp 77% YoY increase in other expenses and whether legal and M&A costs are recurring.
Analysts asked if lower book-to-bill ratios this year are sufficient to sustain revenue growth beyond fiscal 2026.
Analysts questioned how contract renewals and economics have changed compared to 2 years ago given AI productivity benefits.

guidance.statement: TCS and TPG plan to invest up to Rs 18,000 crore over the next few years in HyperVault.
guidance.quote: Together, the partners plan to invest up to ₹ 18,000 crore over the next few years

guidance.statement: Global GDP growth is projected to be 3.1% in 2026 and 3.2% in 2027.
guidance.quote: Global GDP growth is projected to be 3.1% in 2026 and 3.2% in 2027

guidance.statement: TCS plans to expand pan-India footprint by about 50,000 seats in the next 2 to 3 years.
guidance.quote: Expansion of pan‑India footprint further in both Tier‑1 and Tier‑2 cities to the tune of about 50,000 seats in the next 2 to 3 years

guidance.statement: Commitment to reduce absolute Scope 1 and 2 GHG emissions 90% by FY 2030 from FY 2016 base year.
guidance.quote: The Company commits to reduce absolute Scope 1 and 2 GHG emissions 90% by FY 2030 from a FY 2016 base year.

guidance.statement: Commitment to reduce absolute Scope 3 emissions 35% by FY 2034 from FY 2020 base year.
guidance.quote: reduce absolute scope 3 emissions 35% by FY 2034 from a FY 2020 base year.

delivered.statement: FY 2026 consolidated revenue was Rs 267,021 crore, representing a growth of 4.6% over the previous year.
Operating Income was Rs 66,838 crore with an Operating Margin of 25.0%. Net Income reached Rs 52,820 crore.
Total contract value (TCV) exceeded US$ 40 bn with several large deals including 5 mega deals.
Nearly 79% of global energy consumption was sourced from renewables in Fiscal 2026.
Voluntary IT services attrition was 13.7% for FY 2026.
R&D spend was Rs 2,900 crore, representing 1.1% of revenue.

calls.tone: Confident, optimistic about enterprise AI adoption, and focused on full-stack AI transformation and resilient long-term growth.
